responsibility: Contains the autogenerated documentation URL annotations for the generic VxWorks option table in gcc/config/vxworks.opt. It maps VxWorks-specific driver and target switches such as -Bdynamic, -Bstatic, -Xbind-lazy, -Xbind-now, -mrtp, and -non-static to their manual anchors, serving as the documentation companion to the VxWorks option metadata. It does not implement VxWorks specs or target hooks.
